meta.name: Romeo Must Die
meta.description: Two warring gang families (one African-American, the other Chinese) maneuver for bragging rights to the Oakland, California docks. Han Sing and Trish O'Day uncover a trail of deceit that leaves most of the warring factions dead... or worse!
meta.slogan: In a world of vicious rivalries and violent betrayals, only one thing is sure...
